title: Industrial Capacity and Local Conversion Evidence, 2025-2026
summary: Ten reviewed official records connecting national industrial-capacity programs and datasets to the local labor, infrastructure, procurement, permitting, and regulatory evidence needed to assess conversion into delivered capacity.
scope: Phase 55S batch two expands the FTFN authority layer across critical minerals, electricity, construction, labor, semiconductor environmental review, Phoenix capital infrastructure, Toronto procurement planning, and Ontario electricity regulation. It preserves the difference between program selection, reported inventory, authorization, preliminary capital planning, an active regulatory proceeding, and delivered operating outcomes.
download_note: The 13-file archive contains ten official-link records, consolidated summaries, a README, and a SHA-256 manifest. Each record preserves the reviewed official URL and the evidence-stage boundary applied by FTFN.
method_note: Program selection is not an award or operating project; an inventory is not a commitment; a permit authorization is not a start or completion; a preliminary capital pipeline is not a solicitation; a regulatory application is not a decision; and a completed environmental review does not prove construction, qualification, production, local service capacity, or economic outcomes.
